Name: Better Wild Trees
Author: po0pfart
Description:
Whether you're shaking trees for field snack, running whole map to fertilize tree or always short on resources no matter how you plan, this mod solves those issues with these key features:

[list]
[*]Tree health: how many hit to chop down tree (non upgraded axe)
[*]Stand and face next to the tree: press [ to decrease tree stage by 1, press ] to increase tree stage by 1
[*]Growth Chance: chance each day tree grows to next stage (0 never, 1 always)
[*]Seed On Shake Chance: chance each day tree drops seed when shaken (0 never, 1 always)
[*]Grows In Winter: whether tree can grow in winter
[*]Chop Items: how many extra resources drop on chop
[/list]
Mystery box only appears if you have played for 50 days or if you have claimed 2 ticket prizes.

Extra features:
[list]
[*]Book types drop chance and quantity on shake
[*]Mystery box drop chance and quantity on chop
[*]Add morel, chanterelle, magma cap and truffle as mushroom tree tap item
[*]Coconut can be planted and tapped to produce oil
[*]Green rain tree can be tapped for moss
[*]Hazelnut drop whole fall season and quantity can be set
[*]Golden coconut drop chance and quantity on shake
[*]Mushroom hat drop chance and quantity on chop
[*]Quantity, duration and quality of tapper product is configurable
[*]Whether some type of tree become stump on winter
[*]Moss growth chance on common tree
[*]Moss drop on harvest = current tree stage - eligible stage for tree to grow moss
[/list]Check out my other QoL mod too!
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/po0pfart/mods]po0pfart's Mods[/url]
